card.description: A monumental basalt water wheel, 12 m in diameter, carved into a cliffside waterfall and integrated into a temple complex. Wind vanes of obsidian etched with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs catch the breeze, driving bronze gears that turn a polished copper axle. A lattice of quartz crystals surrounds the wheel, refracting water droplets into a luminous mist that bathes the interior with bioluminescent glow. Weathered patina and tactile basalt textures give the device a grounded, industrial mysticism, while the crystalline hardware hints at incomprehensible technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Massive basalt wheel, 12 m diameter, carved with concentric rings, integrated into cliffside, polished copper axle.
**Face/Sensors:** Obsidian wind vanes etched with glyphs, bronze water‑flow sensors, quartz crystal array.
**Clothing/Armor:** Protective basalt casing, copper plating, bronze filigree.
**Key Features:** Wind vanes, water wheel, crystal lattice, bioluminescent algae, ancient glyphs.
evolution: Phase 1 (Initial Wind Harnessing): Installation of wind vanes and bronze gears, enabling mechanical motion.
Phase 2 (Water‑Light Integration): Addition of quartz crystal lattice, water droplets refracted into luminous mist, bioluminescent algae introduced.
